{{Otheruses|Priest}}
{{Image}}
{{Quote|Hey! Isn't the Buggie dressed like some kind of priest?|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref>}}
A '''priest''' (or '''priestess''') was a religious leader, often of an organized religion. Some priests (at least those following the [[Sacred Way/Legends|Sacred Way]] religion) were named [[Pera]] in the [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]] dialect<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 4">{{GamerCite|4|The Starhoppers of Aduba-3}}</ref>.

An example of priests were members of the [[priest caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

{{Deity-stub}}
